projectGoal: Create a unified student portal around the most frequently used services.
productVision: Give students a single entry point for priority digital campus services.
entityDescription: Phase one will include fee payment, examination schedules, and certificate requests while excluding staff administration services.

projectDescription: A platform for storing and retrieving authorized patient records across care encounters.
problemStatement: Clinicians need to locate a patient's current medication list during an appointment.
projectGoal: Provide timely access to relevant patient information.
entityDescription: Authorized clinicians shall be able to retrieve the current medication list associated with a patient's active record.

projectDescription: A platform for managing store tasks, staffing activities, inventory exceptions, and daily operational checks.
problemStatement: Store managers need a shared workflow for coordinating recurring operational work.
projectGoal: Centralize routine store operations and exception handling.
productVision: Give store teams one workspace for daily operational coordination.
entityDescription: Coordinate task assignments, opening checks, inventory exceptions, staffing activities, and completion records.

projectDescription: A platform for collecting measurements from distributed industrial sensors.
problemStatement: Sensor data should not be considered current after remaining unchanged beyond the defined freshness interval.
projectGoal: Prevent stale telemetry from being treated as live information.
entityDescription: A sensor measurement shall be marked stale when no newer reading has been received for 90 seconds.

projectDescription: A service exchanging approved flight-operation messages between airline systems.
problemStatement: Airline applications need standardized communication of flight status changes.
projectGoal: Automate exchange of operational flight information.
productVision: Connect participating airline operational systems through controlled data exchange.
entityDescription: The service shall publish approved departure, arrival, delay, and cancellation events to registered airline systems.

projectDescription: A project extending a research data platform to support selected environmental datasets.
problemStatement: The expansion should focus on approved environmental research datasets rather than all institutional research information.
projectGoal: Extend data-management capabilities to a clearly bounded research area.
productVision: Provide researchers with organized access to selected environmental datasets.
entityDescription: The initial release will support climate and water-quality datasets and exclude human-subject research data.

projectDescription: A portal for customers to manage insurance policies and related service requests.
problemStatement: Policyholders need to download proof of active coverage when required.
projectGoal: Make commonly requested insurance documents readily available.
entityDescription: A customer shall be able to download a current proof-of-coverage document for an active policy.

projectDescription: A platform for planning missions, monitoring drones, managing operators, and reviewing flight outcomes.
problemStatement: Drone operations teams need connected capabilities for managing multiple aircraft and missions.
projectGoal: Provide centralized fleet-level drone operations.
productVision: Coordinate authorized drone missions from planning through post-flight review.
entityDescription: Coordinate mission planning, drone assignment, operator authorization, telemetry monitoring, and post-flight records.

projectDescription: A service for storing and indexing enterprise documents.
problemStatement: Document indexing must complete within an agreed processing window for newly uploaded files.
projectGoal: Keep document search indexes sufficiently current for business users.
entityDescription: Newly uploaded documents shall become searchable within 45 seconds for at least 95 percent of normal uploads.

projectDescription: A connector that sends approved accounting data to an external reporting system.
problemStatement: Finance teams need automated transfer of finalized reporting figures.
projectGoal: Reduce manual movement of accounting information between systems.
productVision: Connect approved financial records with external reporting services.
entityDescription: The connector shall transmit finalized monthly reporting figures to the registered external reporting service using HTTPS.

projectDescription: A pilot project for creating digital representations of selected factory assets.
problemStatement: The pilot should avoid modeling the entire manufacturing plant during the initial evaluation.
projectGoal: Evaluate digital-twin workflows using a limited set of production assets.
productVision: Establish a practical foundation for future factory digital-twin expansion.
entityDescription: The pilot will model two production lines and their critical equipment while excluding warehouse and office facilities.

projectDescription: A portal where customers can submit support requests and follow their progress.
problemStatement: Customers need to provide additional information after opening a support ticket.
projectGoal: Make ongoing communication around support cases easier.
entityDescription: Customers shall be able to add a comment and supporting attachment to an open support ticket.

projectDescription: A platform for monitoring consumption, tariffs, equipment usage, and energy-saving opportunities.
problemStatement: Facility managers need several connected tools to understand and act on energy consumption patterns.
projectGoal: Provide a unified energy-management workspace.
productVision: Help facilities monitor consumption and coordinate energy optimization activities.
entityDescription: Coordinate meter data, consumption analysis, tariff information, equipment usage, alerts, and optimization actions.

projectDescription: A service for storing and retrieving organizational files.
problemStatement: A single object should not exceed the storage service's supported upload size.
projectGoal: Prevent unsupported large uploads from entering the storage workflow.
entityDescription: Individual uploaded objects shall not exceed 10 GB unless a separate large-file transfer workflow is used.

projectDescription: A service connecting a hospital scheduling application with an external physician directory.
problemStatement: Appointment workflows need current provider identifiers and availability information.
projectGoal: Keep provider information synchronized with the approved directory.
productVision: Connect hospital scheduling workflows with external provider information services.
entityDescription: The service shall retrieve physician identifiers, specialties, and availability from the configured provider directory.

projectDescription: A project to modernize selected passenger-information services for a city transit authority.
problemStatement: The initial modernization phase should focus on passenger information rather than fleet maintenance systems.
projectGoal: Improve digital access to public transportation information within a controlled first release.
productVision: Create a clearer passenger-facing information experience across supported transit services.
entityDescription: The first phase will cover route information, service alerts, and stop information while excluding vehicle maintenance and depot operations.

projectDescription: A platform for assigning train crews, managing duty rosters, tracking qualifications, and handling schedule changes.
problemStatement: Railway operators need coordinated crew assignments when services and staff availability change.
projectGoal: Improve the accuracy and visibility of railway crew scheduling.
productVision: Provide planners with a reliable workspace for managing crew duties and operational changes.
entityDescription: The system shall allow authorized planners to assign qualified crew members to scheduled train duties.

projectDescription: A platform providing crop recommendations, field observations, weather information, and seasonal farming guidance.
problemStatement: Farmers need connected information to support decisions throughout the crop cycle.
projectGoal: Provide an integrated digital workspace for agricultural decision support.
productVision: Combine field intelligence and advisory services into one farmer-facing experience.
entityDescription: Coordinate crop observations, weather signals, agronomic recommendations, and farmer actions within a unified workflow.

projectDescription: A service for ingesting, storing, indexing, and retrieving recorded video content for enterprise users.
problemStatement: Large video archives can consume excessive storage when retention is not controlled.
projectGoal: Keep archived video storage within the organization's approved capacity.
entityDescription: Stored video content shall be automatically deleted after 180 days unless a retention hold is active.

projectDescription: A platform supporting cargo declarations, inspection workflows, customs approvals, and release notifications.
problemStatement: Port operators need automated communication with the national customs system.
projectGoal: Reduce manual exchange of cargo clearance information.
productVision: Connect port cargo operations with authorized customs services.
entityDescription: The platform shall exchange cargo declaration and clearance-status messages with the national customs API over HTTPS.

projectDescription: A program replacing selected legacy bus scheduling and passenger information components across a regional transit network.
problemStatement: The modernization effort cannot replace every legacy transit application in its first phase.
projectGoal: Modernize selected passenger and scheduling capabilities within a controlled boundary.
productVision: Create a phased modernization path for core regional transit services.
entityDescription: The first phase includes route scheduling and passenger information services for metropolitan routes while excluding rural depot management.

projectDescription: A web platform for listing items, managing bids, handling auction deadlines, and notifying participants.
problemStatement: Auction participants need timely confirmation when their bids are accepted.
projectGoal: Provide transparent bid submission and status tracking.
productVision: Make online auctions responsive and easy to follow.
entityDescription: The platform shall display confirmation after a valid bid is successfully recorded.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating bed management, patient movement, staffing, discharge planning, and operational alerts.
problemStatement: Hospitals need several connected workflows to coordinate daily operational capacity.
projectGoal: Provide a unified operational coordination capability for hospital administrators.
productVision: Connect operational signals and workflows across hospital departments.
entityDescription: Coordinate bed availability, patient movement, staffing signals, discharge planning, and escalation workflows.

projectDescription: A service for registering sensors, collecting readings, tracking device health, and managing telemetry metadata.
problemStatement: High-frequency sensor ingestion can overload processing resources if message rates are uncontrolled.
projectGoal: Prevent excessive telemetry rates from destabilizing the ingestion service.
entityDescription: Individual registered devices shall not publish more than 20 telemetry messages per second under the standard service profile.

projectDescription: A platform for submitting claims, reviewing documents, assessing cases, and communicating claim decisions.
problemStatement: Insurers need automated document exchange with external identity and verification providers.
projectGoal: Reduce manual verification during claim processing.
productVision: Connect claims workflows with trusted verification services.
entityDescription: The platform shall submit claimant identity verification requests to the approved external identity service through its REST API.

projectDescription: A project extending an existing museum platform with selected visitor-facing digital services.
problemStatement: The expansion is limited to visitor engagement capabilities and does not replace physical ticketing infrastructure.
projectGoal: Extend digital visitor services without altering core museum operations.
productVision: Expand the museum's digital experience around selected visitor journeys.
entityDescription: The project includes digital exhibit guides and visitor notifications but excludes replacement of physical access-control equipment.

projectDescription: A platform for tracking vehicle fuel usage, refueling events, fuel cards, and consumption reports.
problemStatement: Fleet managers need visibility into fuel transactions for individual vehicles.
projectGoal: Improve monitoring of fleet fuel consumption.
productVision: Provide reliable fuel activity tracking for fleet operations.
entityDescription: The system shall allow authorized users to view fuel transactions associated with a selected vehicle.

projectDescription: A platform combining classroom scheduling, attendance, digital content, device coordination, and teaching analytics.
problemStatement: Educational institutions need multiple classroom capabilities working together rather than isolated tools.
projectGoal: Provide a connected environment for digitally enabled classrooms.
productVision: Bring scheduling, teaching resources, classroom devices, and analytics into one platform.
entityDescription: Coordinate room schedules, attendance events, digital content, device status, and teaching analytics.

projectDescription: A service that reconciles payment records received from multiple transaction channels.
problemStatement: Reconciliation jobs may compete for limited processing resources during peak settlement periods.
projectGoal: Control the processing load generated by reconciliation workers.
entityDescription: A reconciliation worker shall process no more than 5,000 transaction records in a single execution batch.

projectDescription: A platform for scholarship applications, eligibility checks, document review, and award management.
problemStatement: Universities need automated access to approved student enrollment information.
projectGoal: Reduce repeated manual entry during scholarship verification.
productVision: Connect scholarship processing with authoritative university records.
entityDescription: The platform shall retrieve current enrollment status from the university student information system through an authenticated API.

projectDescription: A project introducing digital safety reporting for selected manufacturing facilities.
problemStatement: The initial deployment is intended for operational safety events rather than every corporate compliance process.
projectGoal: Digitize incident reporting within the selected manufacturing operations.
productVision: Establish a focused digital foundation for workplace safety reporting.
entityDescription: The first release covers incident and near-miss reporting at production facilities and excludes corporate environmental compliance workflows.

projectDescription: A service for managing subscriptions, plans, billing status, and customer access to digital content.
problemStatement: Subscribers need to know when their account access changes after a successful payment.
projectGoal: Provide clear subscription access status.
productVision: Make subscription status understandable across billing and content experiences.
entityDescription: The platform shall update a subscriber's content-access status after a confirmed successful renewal payment.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating delivery requests, robot assignment, route planning, navigation status, and delivery completion.
problemStatement: Autonomous delivery operations require several coordinated capabilities to complete deliveries reliably.
projectGoal: Provide end-to-end orchestration for robotic delivery operations.
productVision: Connect customer requests with robotic planning and execution workflows.
entityDescription: Coordinate order intake, robot selection, route planning, navigation events, exception handling, and delivery confirmation.

projectDescription: A service processing support interactions and generating operational analytics.
problemStatement: Analytical processing should not consume excessive resources during normal support operations.
projectGoal: Limit the size of individual analytical processing requests.
entityDescription: A single analytics export request shall contain no more than 250,000 support interaction records.

projectDescription: A platform collecting smart meter readings and preparing billing information for utility systems.
problemStatement: Utility billing applications need standardized access to validated meter readings.
projectGoal: Automate transfer of validated consumption data to billing systems.
productVision: Connect metering operations with authorized utility billing applications.
entityDescription: The platform shall provide an authenticated REST endpoint through which the billing system can retrieve validated meter readings.

projectDescription: A project improving digital booking and availability services for selected public sports facilities.
problemStatement: The upgrade should focus on facility reservations and availability rather than broader municipal recreation services.
projectGoal: Improve digital access to selected sports facilities.
productVision: Provide a focused booking experience for community sports facilities.
entityDescription: The project includes booking for indoor courts and swimming lanes while excluding outdoor park maintenance scheduling.

projectDescription: A platform for catalog search, digital borrowing, reading history, and account management.
problemStatement: Library users need to renew eligible digital loans without contacting staff.
projectGoal: Simplify digital loan management for library members.
productVision: Make digital borrowing and account management convenient for library users.
entityDescription: Users shall be able to renew an eligible digital loan before its current expiration time.

projectDescription: A platform supporting shelter registration, capacity monitoring, resource allocation, volunteer coordination, and emergency communications.
problemStatement: Emergency agencies need coordinated shelter operations during large-scale incidents.
projectGoal: Provide an integrated capability for managing temporary shelter operations.
productVision: Connect shelter capacity, people, resources, and response teams during emergencies.
entityDescription: Coordinate registrations, occupancy levels, resource requests, volunteer assignments, and emergency notifications.

projectDescription: A service converting uploaded documents between supported file formats.
problemStatement: Large conversion jobs can exhaust worker memory when individual files are excessively large.
projectGoal: Prevent oversized documents from consuming conversion resources.
entityDescription: The service shall reject document conversion requests containing an individual file larger than 500 MB.

projectDescription: A platform for digital menus, order placement, kitchen processing, payment, and delivery coordination.
problemStatement: Restaurants need orders sent automatically to their existing kitchen display systems.
projectGoal: Reduce manual transfer of online orders into kitchen workflows.
productVision: Connect customer ordering with restaurant operational systems.
entityDescription: The platform shall transmit confirmed food orders to the restaurant's configured kitchen display system using the supported integration protocol.

projectDescription: A program introducing selected digital services for visitors across participating coastal destinations.
problemStatement: The program has limited initial coverage and cannot include every tourism service in the region.
projectGoal: Establish a focused digital visitor experience for participating destinations.
productVision: Create a shared digital foundation for selected coastal visitor services.
entityDescription: The first release covers attraction information and visitor alerts for participating destinations while excluding hotel property-management systems.

projectDescription: A platform for tracking stock levels, storage locations, receipts, transfers, and inventory adjustments.
problemStatement: Warehouse operators need immediate visibility into the current quantity of a selected stock item.
projectGoal: Improve accuracy of warehouse inventory visibility.
productVision: Provide dependable inventory information for warehouse operations.
entityDescription: The system shall display the current recorded quantity and storage location for a selected inventory item.

projectDescription: A platform supporting budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, approvals, and management reporting.
problemStatement: Finance teams need several connected planning activities within one controlled workspace.
projectGoal: Provide integrated financial planning workflows.
productVision: Connect budgeting decisions with forecasts, scenarios, approvals, and reporting.
entityDescription: Coordinate budget preparation, forecast revisions, scenario comparisons, approval workflows, and management reporting.

projectDescription: A service for backing up application data and restoring selected datasets.
problemStatement: Backup retention can increase storage consumption beyond the approved operational budget.
projectGoal: Keep backup retention within defined storage-management rules.
entityDescription: Standard application backups shall be retained for 45 days unless a longer retention policy is explicitly configured.

projectDescription: A platform for vehicle registration, ownership records, fee processing, and certificate issuance.
problemStatement: The platform needs verified ownership information from the national vehicle registry.
projectGoal: Reduce duplicate entry during ownership verification.
productVision: Connect registration workflows with authoritative vehicle records.
entityDescription: The platform shall query the national vehicle registry through its authorized vehicle-ownership verification service.

projectDescription: A pilot introducing digital services for selected public parks.
problemStatement: The pilot is limited to visitor information and facility reporting and does not cover park maintenance operations.
projectGoal: Evaluate selected digital services before broader deployment.
productVision: Test focused digital services in participating public parks.
entityDescription: The pilot includes visitor information and facility issue reporting for five parks and excludes maintenance-work-order management.

projectDescription: A platform for creating exams, enrolling candidates, delivering assessments, and recording results.
problemStatement: Candidates need to resume an interrupted assessment when the exam policy permits it.
projectGoal: Support controlled continuation of interrupted online assessments.
productVision: Provide dependable digital assessment workflows for institutions.
entityDescription: The platform shall allow an eligible candidate to resume an interrupted examination from the latest saved state.

projectDescription: A platform integrating traffic signals, incident monitoring, road sensors, congestion analytics, and operator workflows.
problemStatement: Traffic control centers need several coordinated capabilities to manage changing road conditions.
projectGoal: Provide integrated operational visibility for urban traffic management.
productVision: Connect traffic sensing, incident response, and signal operations.
entityDescription: Coordinate sensor feeds, incident detection, signal status, congestion analysis, and operator response workflows.

projectDescription: A service that indexes documents and serves search queries for enterprise applications.
problemStatement: Unbounded index growth can consume available storage and degrade operational stability.
projectGoal: Keep active search indexes within the configured storage allocation.
entityDescription: The indexing service shall pause new indexing when active index storage reaches 90 percent of the configured capacity.

projectDescription: A platform for flight search, reservations, passenger records, payment, and ticket issuance.
problemStatement: The reservation platform needs current seat inventory from an external airline inventory system.
projectGoal: Prevent stale seat availability from causing incorrect bookings.
productVision: Connect reservation workflows with authoritative airline inventory.
entityDescription: The platform shall retrieve current seat availability from the configured airline inventory service through its supported API.

projectDescription: A project deploying selected digital monitoring capabilities across a regional water network.
problemStatement: The initial project cannot instrument every water asset in the region.
projectGoal: Establish monitoring coverage for priority water infrastructure.
productVision: Create a focused monitoring foundation for critical water assets.
entityDescription: The first phase covers reservoir outlets and primary treatment facilities while excluding household-level consumption meters.

projectDescription: A platform for recording employee expenses, attaching receipts, submitting claims, and tracking approvals.
problemStatement: Employees need to attach supporting receipts to expense claims from mobile devices.
projectGoal: Simplify mobile expense submission.
productVision: Make expense reporting practical for employees working away from desks.
entityDescription: The mobile application shall allow users to attach a receipt image to an expense claim before submission.

projectDescription: A platform for coordinating trial participants, study visits, clinical data, monitoring activities, and compliance workflows.
problemStatement: Research teams need interconnected workflows to manage clinical studies from enrollment through monitoring.
projectGoal: Provide integrated clinical trial operations.
productVision: Connect participant management, visits, study data, monitoring, and compliance activities.
entityDescription: Coordinate participant enrollment, visit scheduling, study data collection, monitoring actions, and compliance tracking.

projectDescription: A service collecting security and operational logs from distributed infrastructure.
problemStatement: Excessive individual log messages can increase ingestion and storage costs.
projectGoal: Prevent oversized log events from entering the standard ingestion pipeline.
entityDescription: A single log event shall not exceed 256 KB after normalization before it is accepted by the ingestion pipeline.

projectDescription: A platform helping businesses prepare tax submissions and supporting documents.
problemStatement: The platform needs submission acknowledgements from the government tax filing service.
projectGoal: Provide reliable confirmation of submitted tax returns.
productVision: Connect business tax workflows with the authorized government filing service.
entityDescription: The platform shall submit completed tax return packages to the government filing service through its approved electronic submission interface.

projectDescription: A project digitizing selected records related to protected heritage properties.
problemStatement: The digitization effort has limited record categories for its initial phase.
projectGoal: Create a searchable digital foundation for selected heritage records.
productVision: Preserve and organize priority heritage information in digital form.
entityDescription: The first phase includes property descriptions and conservation assessments while excluding private ownership documents.

projectDescription: A platform allowing customers to request eligible prescription refills and track fulfillment status.
problemStatement: Customers need confirmation when a refill request has been successfully submitted.
projectGoal: Make refill requests easier to submit and track.
productVision: Provide a straightforward digital refill workflow for eligible prescriptions.
entityDescription: The system shall display a confirmation reference after an eligible refill request is successfully submitted.

projectDescription: A platform managing ocean observations, vessel measurements, laboratory samples, research datasets, and analysis workflows.
problemStatement: Marine researchers need multiple related capabilities to move from field collection to scientific analysis.
projectGoal: Provide integrated marine research data management.
productVision: Connect field observations with sample records and analytical datasets.
entityDescription: Coordinate vessel observations, sample metadata, laboratory results, dataset curation, and analysis workflows.

projectDescription: A service responsible for generating and delivering transactional notifications.
problemStatement: Uncontrolled notification bursts can overload downstream mail infrastructure.
projectGoal: Control the outbound notification rate.
entityDescription: The service shall limit outbound transactional email delivery to 1,000 messages per minute per tenant.

projectDescription: A platform for employee records, payroll calculations, deductions, payslips, and payment preparation.
problemStatement: Payroll administrators need validated bank-account information from the organization's banking partner.
projectGoal: Reduce manual verification of employee payment destinations.
productVision: Connect payroll processing with approved banking verification services.
entityDescription: The platform shall submit employee payment-account details to the approved banking verification service before payment preparation.

projectDescription: A pilot introducing selected digital tools for coordinating mountain rescue teams.
problemStatement: The pilot focuses on operational coordination and does not attempt to replace existing emergency radio systems.
projectGoal: Evaluate selected digital support for rescue coordination.
productVision: Introduce targeted digital capabilities without replacing established emergency infrastructure.
entityDescription: The pilot includes team location sharing and incident assignment while excluding replacement of the existing emergency radio network.

projectDescription: A platform for property listings, tenant applications, lease records, rent tracking, and maintenance requests.
problemStatement: Property managers need applicants to receive confirmation after submitting a rental application.
projectGoal: Improve transparency of rental application submission.
productVision: Provide a clear application workflow for prospective tenants.
entityDescription: The platform shall provide an application reference number after a rental application is successfully submitted.

projectDescription: A platform for equipment records, preventive maintenance, work orders, spare parts, inspections, and technician scheduling.
problemStatement: Industrial operators need coordinated maintenance planning across equipment and field teams.
projectGoal: Provide integrated maintenance operations.
productVision: Connect asset information with maintenance planning and technician execution.
entityDescription: Coordinate preventive schedules, work orders, inspections, spare-parts availability, and technician assignments.

projectDescription: A service accepting images for transformation and analysis.
problemStatement: Very large image payloads can exceed gateway memory and processing limits.
projectGoal: Prevent oversized uploads from entering the image processing pipeline.
entityDescription: The gateway shall reject an image upload larger than 25 MB before processing begins.

projectDescription: A platform for searching travel options, managing reservations, and tracking itinerary changes.
problemStatement: The booking platform needs availability data from external railway reservation services.
projectGoal: Provide current rail availability during travel searches.
productVision: Connect travel planning with participating railway reservation systems.
entityDescription: The platform shall query participating railway reservation services for current seat availability through their approved APIs.

projectDescription: A project introducing digital monitoring for selected commercial fishing activities.
problemStatement: The first phase covers a subset of fishing records and does not include recreational fishing data.
projectGoal: Establish controlled digital monitoring for selected commercial fisheries.
productVision: Create a focused data foundation for fisheries oversight.
entityDescription: The first phase includes licensed commercial catch records and vessel activity while excluding recreational fishing records.

projectDescription: A platform for courses, enrollments, learning progress, assessments, and completion records.
problemStatement: Employees need to see the courses in which they are currently enrolled.
projectGoal: Improve visibility of individual learning activity.
productVision: Give employees a simple view of their active learning commitments.
entityDescription: The portal shall display all currently active course enrollments for the signed-in employee.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating production schedules, machine telemetry, quality checks, maintenance events, and operator workflows.
problemStatement: Factories need connected operational information across production and equipment processes.
projectGoal: Provide integrated visibility into factory operations.
productVision: Connect production planning, machine signals, quality activities, and maintenance operations.
entityDescription: Coordinate production schedules, equipment telemetry, quality inspections, maintenance events, and operator actions.

projectDescription: A service routing and securing API requests for multiple internal applications.
problemStatement: API requests must complete within the gateway's configured connection lifetime.
projectGoal: Prevent inactive requests from occupying gateway resources indefinitely.
entityDescription: The gateway shall terminate an upstream connection that remains inactive for more than 90 seconds.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating patient referrals between healthcare organizations.
problemStatement: Receiving hospitals need referral information through an approved healthcare interoperability channel.
projectGoal: Support standardized exchange of referral information.
productVision: Connect referring and receiving organizations through controlled healthcare interoperability.
entityDescription: The platform shall transmit approved referral records to participating hospitals through the configured FHIR-based integration.

projectDescription: A project digitizing maintenance records for selected agricultural machinery.
problemStatement: The program initially covers equipment operated by participating cooperatives rather than the entire agricultural fleet.
projectGoal: Digitize maintenance information for the selected equipment population.
productVision: Establish a manageable digital maintenance record for participating agricultural machinery.
entityDescription: The first release covers tractors and harvesters registered with participating cooperatives and excludes privately owned machinery.

projectDescription: A platform for loyalty accounts, points, rewards, promotions, and redemption history.
problemStatement: Customers need their available points balance after eligible transactions are processed.
projectGoal: Provide timely visibility into loyalty balances.
productVision: Make loyalty activity easy for customers to understand.
entityDescription: The platform shall display the customer's updated points balance after a qualifying transaction is posted.

projectDescription: A platform for monitoring network services, incidents, alarms, performance metrics, and restoration workflows.
problemStatement: Telecom operators need connected capabilities to detect and coordinate responses to service degradation.
projectGoal: Provide integrated service assurance operations.
productVision: Connect network monitoring with incident and restoration workflows.
entityDescription: Coordinate alarms, performance metrics, incident creation, service impact analysis, and restoration tracking.

projectDescription: A service generating downloadable exports from enterprise datasets.
problemStatement: Large exports can create excessive temporary storage usage.
projectGoal: Restrict the size of generated export packages.
entityDescription: A single generated export package shall not exceed 2 GB under the standard export profile.

projectDescription: A platform managing building sensors, access events, energy data, and facility alerts.
problemStatement: The building platform needs electricity consumption data from the external utility provider.
projectGoal: Improve visibility into building energy usage.
productVision: Connect building operations with trusted utility consumption data.
entityDescription: The platform shall retrieve interval electricity consumption data from the configured utility provider through its approved data service.

projectDescription: A project extending broadband service management to selected underserved communities.
problemStatement: The expansion phase cannot cover every unserved location simultaneously.
projectGoal: Extend service management to prioritized communities within the available rollout capacity.
productVision: Provide a controlled foundation for phased broadband expansion.
entityDescription: The first phase covers prioritized community clusters identified by the deployment plan and excludes remote sites requiring new backbone construction.

projectDescription: A platform for creating invoices, tracking payment status, managing customers, and generating financial records.
problemStatement: Finance users need to download a copy of an issued invoice for their records.
projectGoal: Improve access to issued billing documents.
productVision: Make invoice management convenient for finance teams.
entityDescription: Authorized users shall be able to download a PDF copy of an issued invoice.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating gate assignments, turnaround tasks, baggage status, ground crews, and operational alerts.
problemStatement: Airport teams need several related workflows to coordinate aircraft turnaround activities.
projectGoal: Provide integrated visibility into ground operations.
productVision: Connect turnaround activities across airport operational teams.
entityDescription: Coordinate gate allocation, ground-service tasks, baggage milestones, crew actions, and turnaround alerts.

projectDescription: A service accepting files for storage and downstream processing.
problemStatement: Unlimited upload size can create resource and security risks.
projectGoal: Keep individual file uploads within the supported service boundary.
entityDescription: A single uploaded file shall not exceed 1 GB unless an approved large-file policy is enabled.

projectDescription: A platform supporting fare calculation, ticket purchases, travel accounts, and payment reconciliation.
problemStatement: The platform needs transaction authorization from an external payment processor.
projectGoal: Enable secure processing of passenger fare payments.
productVision: Connect fare collection with approved payment processing services.
entityDescription: The platform shall send fare payment authorization requests to the configured external payment processor.

projectDescription: A project delivering selected digital advisory services to participating farming communities.
problemStatement: The first rollout is limited to crop advisory and weather information rather than the full range of agricultural services.
projectGoal: Provide focused digital support for participating farmers.
productVision: Establish a practical digital advisory service for selected farming communities.
entityDescription: The rollout includes crop guidance and weather alerts while excluding digital machinery leasing and commodity trading services.

projectDescription: A platform for event creation, attendee registration, ticketing, and attendance tracking.
problemStatement: Attendees need confirmation immediately after completing a valid registration.
projectGoal: Provide reliable registration feedback.
productVision: Make event registration simple and transparent.
entityDescription: The system shall display a unique registration reference after successful attendee registration.

projectDescription: A platform for managing substations, transformers, inspections, maintenance, outages, and asset history.
problemStatement: Utility engineers need several connected capabilities to manage the lifecycle of electrical assets.
projectGoal: Provide integrated utility asset management.
productVision: Connect asset records with inspections, maintenance, and outage-related workflows.
entityDescription: Coordinate asset registration, inspection planning, maintenance actions, outage history, and lifecycle reporting.

projectDescription: A service distributing asynchronous messages between application components.
problemStatement: Excessive queue retention can consume storage and delay operational cleanup.
projectGoal: Limit how long unprocessed messages remain in the standard queue.
entityDescription: Unprocessed messages shall expire after 72 hours unless the queue is configured with an extended retention policy.

projectDescription: A platform for product listings, seller management, orders, payments, and fulfillment tracking.
problemStatement: The marketplace needs shipment status information from external logistics providers.
projectGoal: Provide current delivery information to buyers and sellers.
productVision: Connect marketplace orders with participating logistics services.
entityDescription: The platform shall retrieve shipment status updates from registered logistics providers through their supported tracking APIs.

projectDescription: A program digitizing selected administrative workflows across participating clinics.
problemStatement: The initial program is focused on appointment administration and excludes clinical diagnosis workflows.
projectGoal: Digitize selected administrative healthcare processes.
productVision: Create a controlled digital foundation for participating clinics.
entityDescription: The first phase includes appointment scheduling and patient registration while excluding clinical diagnosis and treatment planning.

projectDescription: A platform for storing, organizing, searching, and distributing enterprise media assets.
problemStatement: Content managers need to find an asset using its unique reference identifier.
projectGoal: Improve retrieval of stored digital assets.
productVision: Provide fast and predictable asset discovery for content teams.
entityDescription: The platform shall return the asset associated with a valid unique asset identifier.

projectDescription: A platform coordinating inspections, defect records, quality measurements, corrective actions, and audit evidence.
problemStatement: Manufacturers need connected workflows to manage quality activities from inspection through corrective action.
projectGoal: Provide integrated quality management operations.
productVision: Connect quality inspections with defects, corrective actions, and audit workflows.
entityDescription: Coordinate inspections, measurements, defect classification, corrective actions, approvals, and audit evidence.

projectDescription: A service executing analytical queries over enterprise datasets.
problemStatement: Unbounded analytical queries can consume excessive compute resources.
projectGoal: Limit execution time for standard analytical queries.
entityDescription: A standard analytical query shall be terminated after 120 seconds unless the requesting role has an extended execution policy.

projectDescription: A platform for identity registration, authentication, account recovery, and access management.
problemStatement: The identity service needs verification results from an external government identity provider for selected workflows.
projectGoal: Support verified identity checks during account enrollment.
productVision: Connect identity workflows with authorized external verification services.
entityDescription: The platform shall submit eligible identity verification requests to the configured government identity provider.
